messages:
sam: Heads-up — noticed Dedicated customers seeing invoice delta after a traffic spike. Looks like retries from our edge are being counted twice when they hit the quota-exception path.

maria: Ugh. Is this the path that applies the `quota_penalty` tag?

sam: Yeah. Sequence: request -> edge retries on transient 5xx -> routed to fallback pool -> fallback handler marks `quota_penalty=true` and emits billing event. Edge then replays original request and we count normal event too.

lia: Can you paste the event examples?

sam: Sure, example payloads we saw in S3: 
```
{"tenant":"acme","route":"dedicated-gpu","tokens":120,"tags":["retry"],"penalty":true}
{"tenant":"acme","route":"dedicated-gpu","tokens":120,"tags":[],"penalty":false}
```

rahul: So two separate events for the same logical request. We need dedupe upstream by request_id, but edge proxies sometimes rewrite ids when they retry.

maria: Why are proxies rewriting ids? They call `clientlib.v2()` which should preserve `x-request-id`.

sam: Our 1.3 clientlib added `idempotency_key` and some proxies fallback to a generated header when they think an attempt failed — we didn't enforce `x-request-id` propagation in the fallback path.

ops-bot: ALERT: invoice_preview anomalies spike for tenant acme (+18%) in last 15m — linked: https://console/redwood/invoices/preview/acme

lia: We could dedupe in the billing pipeline by (tenant, session_id, rounded_minute, tokens). Risk: genuine high-frequency multi-request patterns might collapse.

rahul: Alternative: set a stronger contract in the API: always attach `x-request-id` from caller and treat any generated id as `attempt_id`. Then only count events where `attempt_id==primary` or where `penalty` flag is false.

dave: For Dedicated customers we already promised strict accounting. I think we should opt for conservative dedupe in postprocess + a short-term rollback of the `quota_penalty` emit in fallback handler while we fix proxies.

maria: How many tenants impacted?

sam: Found 7 tenants so far, mostly heavy bursters on Dedicated. Estimated delta total ~6%.

rahul: Quick patch idea: in the ingest lambda add `source_attempt_id` normalization — if `x-original-request-id` exists, prefer it. Also add a tag `ingest_dedup_v1` for telemetry.

lia: We'll need dashboard changes so CS doesn't panic — a separate chart showing "penalty-tagged events" vs "deduped events" by tenant for invoice-preview window.

maria: Can we avoid changing invoices retroactively? Ops says no. Show adjustments as "pending audit" line item instead.

ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC for ingest lambda; deploy proposed patch as canary first.

sam: Plan I'm proposing: 1) Patch fallback path to stop emitting penalty events immediately (hotfix), 2) Deploy ingest dedupe lambda (canary to 5%), 3) Add dashboard tiles and an email to CS with tenant list, 4) Run backfill to remove duplicates for the last 24h and mark as audit pending (if owner approves).

dave: +1 to hotfix now. Lia and Rahul, can you own the canary and dashboard respectively?

lia: I can own the canary. Will monitor for false positives (legit double events).

rahul: I'll add the dashboard tiles and a small API in Console to show candidate duplicates and allow CS to flag for manual review.

maria: I'll draft the CS message and audit template. Sam, pls include sample event ids.

sam: Posting sample request_ids: `req_0a1b2c`, `req_0a1b2c_attempt_2` — we'll use these to test the dedupe.

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: hotfix branch deployed to canary cluster at 5381234075 by sam — tags: hotfix/quota-penalty-stop

lia: Canary looks clean for 15m, no sign of undercounting. Metrics: penalty_event_rate -> 0.002 -> 0.0003, invoice_preview_delta -> -0.1%.

rahul: Dashboard PR: https://git/redwood/console/pulls/4567 adds dedupe card and tenant drilldown. Patch notes included.

maria: Sending CS email now with tenant list and "pending audit" wording.

dave: Good work team. We'll follow up tomorrow for backfill decision. :thumbsup:
